name: owner_candle_break_15_nyam_1tr_same

source.title: Owner's idea in chat, 2026-10-18: a 15-minute candle that closes beyond the previous candle's wick, entered with it; stop at the candle extreme, 1:0.5; NY morning, 1 trade a day; no EMA; both candles the trade's colour (green green long, red red short)

entry.words: On 15-minute candles, when a candle closes above the previous candle's high, go long at the close; when it closes below the previous candle's low, go short. Stop at the candle's extreme, target half the risk (1 : 0.5). Both the previous candle and the breaking candle must be green for a long, both red for a short.

taught: [chat 2026-10-18] now lets start the new idea and add it to sweep, lets just try if the candle closes over the previous candles wick we enter, same stop idea and tp
[chat 2026-10-18] (the setting of the saved sweep: 15-minute candles, NY morning, 1 trade a day; this sheet without the EMA)
[chat 2026-10-18] okay now for the break try the green green / red red
not_run: THE WICK: 'closes over the previous candle's wick' is read as a close strictly above the previous candle's high (long) or strictly below its low (short); a close on it is nothing.
THE COLOURS: green = close above open, red = close below; a doji is neither. Long = both green, short = both red.

THE STOP: the sweeping candle's extreme, measured from its close and placed from the fill at the next bar's open; floored at 0.25 x ATR(14) of the 15-minute bars, as every structure stop of the engine.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days); no trade is held overnight.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: build days only.
THE CAP: 1 trade a day (the first signal of NY morning that passes the EMA side); one session pass, so it is the day's cap.
